status: Phase 4. Thresholds decided as defaults (D55), configurable per supplier in the supplier register. The anchor, the follow-up states and the dependency description are Proposed.

supplier_follow_up.per_supplier: supplier.follow_up_threshold_days and supplier.escalation_threshold_days override the defaults
supplier_follow_up.anchor: the sent time of the supplier's latest email in the package (its last answer)
supplier_follow_up.follow_up_when: the supplier has not given a firm commitment: its date is a forecast or there is no date

states.not_due: as-of date before the first follow-up date
states.follow_up_due: as-of date on or after the first follow-up date and before the escalation date
states.escalation_due: as-of date on or after the escalation date

supplier_inputs.note: D62: per order, supplier inputs are 'complete' when every supplier dependency has a date and 'missing' otherwise. This is not a delivery forecast: delivery stays 'not estimable - no standard interval' (D61). The absence of a date is reported as unknown, never as a delay (UC05).
